incumbent: v3.2 frozen lateral system (v2.8 base + v3.2 learned curve-route adapter; no runtime RouteAssist or SafetySupervisor)

evaluation.deployment: raw learned policy; SafetySupervisor OFF; RouteAssist OFF
evaluation.aggregation: paired by scenario and training seed; do not treat 45/36 episodes as independent training repetitions

lexicographic_gate: continuous metrics only after binary gates
model complexity only as final tie-break

standard_regression_gate.aggregate_min_success: 44/45 across the three formal training seeds
standard_regression_gate.curve_requirement: no collision or off-road on any validation16 curve scenario across formal training seeds
standard_regression_gate.canonical_seed_requirement: seed 13400 must have at least 14/15 success and zero catastrophic

interaction_gate.reference: v3.2 incumbent evaluated once on the same 12 validation16 interaction scenarios, replicated only for paired treatment bookkeeping
requirements: candidate aggregate catastrophic count must not exceed replicated incumbent catastrophic count
candidate aggregate success count must not be below replicated incumbent success count
at least one of success or catastrophic count must be strictly better

release19_rule: Only GPL may be promoted if it passes both gates and is not inferior to G0 under the same lexicographic rule. Release19 uses the precommitted seed-13400 GPL artifact; no best-seed selection is allowed.
no_promotion_rule: If no treatment passes both gates, release19 remains unopened and v3.2 remains incumbent.
